description: Phase 6 (validation doc) + Phase 8 (marketplace readiness): Write the manual VALIDATION.md covering ref.md section 8 scenarios 1-18 excluding #16 (JetBrains), add missing packaging files (CHANGELOG.md, LICENSE, root LICENSE), rewrite the stale extensions/vscode/README.md, add FEATURES/INSTALL/TROUBLESHOOTING docs, and document the VS Code Marketplace + Open VSX publishing paths with explicit Kiro/Cursor/Windsurf support. Depends on FEAT-002 (uses the docs/ui screenshots). Does not delete ref.md/reference yet — that is FEAT-004.
steps: Write extensions/vscode/docs/VALIDATION.md enumerating ref.md section 8 scenarios 1-15, 17, 18 (EXCLUDE #16 JetBrains compatibility). For each: steps, expected result, status (PASS / NOT VERIFIED / N/A with reason). Mark #4 first-time QR pairing and #13 QR pairing timeout as 'NOT VERIFIED — requires a real Android 11+ device'. Reference docs/ui/manager-light.png + manager-dark.png for #17 (light/dark themes) and manager-narrow.png for #18 (narrow window). Add a 'Supported IDEs' section listing VS Code, Kiro, Cursor, Windsurf and other VS Code-based hosts (install via Open VSX or VSIX); JetBrains out of scope.

Create extensions/vscode/CHANGELOG.md (Keep-a-Changelog style) with a 0.2.0 entry summarizing: ADB engine, real QR + 6-digit pairing, mDNS discovery, device manager, smart auto-reconnect, multi-device, status bar, settings; and note VS Code + Open VSX (Kiro/Cursor/Windsurf) packaging.

Create extensions/vscode/LICENSE and a repo-root LICENSE, both the standard MIT license text matching the declared MIT license in package.json. Use a placeholder copyright holder (e.g. 'ADB Connect contributors') — do not invent a real legal entity. These satisfy the .vscodeignore entries that already reference LICENSE and CHANGELOG.md.

Rewrite extensions/vscode/README.md (currently STALE: it wrongly says QR pairing is 'Not yet implemented' and lists non-existent settings refreshIntervalSeconds/knownEndpoints). New README: one-line pitch; supported IDEs (VS Code, Kiro, Cursor, Windsurf, other VS Code-based — JetBrains out of scope); features; the seven real settings (adbPath, autoDiscover, autoReconnect, reconnectOnStartup, showStatusBar, preferredDevice, debugLogging); quick-start (QR / 6-digit / IP connect); embed the Phase 7 screenshots from docs/ui/; troubleshooting summary; privacy policy description (no telemetry, no secrets stored, adb keeps pairing keys in ~/.android); publisher 'guitar-dev-io' and repo URLs kept as PLACEHOLDERS.

Create extensions/vscode/docs/FEATURES.md, INSTALL.md, TROUBLESHOOTING.md. INSTALL.md must document BOTH channels: VS Code Marketplace (for VS Code) and Open VSX (for Kiro, Cursor, Windsurf and other VS Code-based IDEs), plus install-from-VSIX (`code --install-extension <vsix>` and the IDE 'Install from VSIX' UI). Reference the package:ovsx npm script for the Open VSX publish flow. TROUBLESHOOTING.md should reuse the adb-not-found and ADB_BLOCKED_HINT (firewall/Local Network/mDNS blocked, VPN, Android 11+, platform-tools 31+) guidance from packages/core/src/adb/diagnose.ts. Link all three from README.

Verify the Open VSX packaging path: confirm extensions/vscode/package.json engines.vscode stays ^1.85.0 (do not raise unless an incompatibility is found) and extensionKind ['ui','workspace'] is retained; confirm no VS Code API above 1.85 is used in src/ (exploration found none). Document the verified supported-IDE matrix in findings.
acceptance_criteria: extensions/vscode/docs/VALIDATION.md lists scenarios 1-15, 17, 18 (not #16), marks QR scenarios NOT VERIFIED, references the docs/ui screenshots for #17/#18, and includes a Supported IDEs section naming Kiro/Cursor/Windsurf.
extensions/vscode/CHANGELOG.md, extensions/vscode/LICENSE and root LICENSE exist (MIT, placeholder holder).
extensions/vscode/README.md no longer claims QR is unimplemented and lists the seven real settings, supported IDEs, and the docs/ui screenshots.
extensions/vscode/docs/{FEATURES,INSTALL,TROUBLESHOOTING}.md exist and are linked from README; INSTALL.md covers Open VSX (Kiro/Cursor/Windsurf) and VSIX install.
verification: npm run -w extensions/vscode package (completes without warning about missing LICENSE/CHANGELOG; note: this step may still fail on the stray root dist FILE, which FEAT-004 removes — if so, record that and defer the packaging assertion to FEAT-004)
Confirm README, VALIDATION.md, and INSTALL.md contents by reading them back
findings: Docs written/rewritten: extensions/vscode/docs/VALIDATION.md (scenarios 1-15,17,18; #16 N/A JetBrains out of scope; #4 and #13 QR = NOT VERIFIED (requires real Android 11+ device); #17 references docs/ui/manager-light.png + manager-dark.png, #18 references manager-narrow.png; Supported IDEs section added), CHANGELOG.md (Keep-a-Changelog 0.2.0), extensions/vscode/LICENSE + repo-root LICENSE (MIT, holder 'ADB Connect contributors'), README.md rewritten (removed stale 'QR not implemented' claim and the non-existent refreshIntervalSeconds/knownEndpoints settings; now lists the 7 real settings adbPath/autoDiscover/autoReconnect/reconnectOnStartup/showStatusBar/preferredDevice/debugLogging, embeds docs/ui screenshots, publisher guitar-dev-io + repo URLs kept as placeholders), docs/FEATURES.md, docs/INSTALL.md (VS Code Marketplace + Open VSX for Kiro/Cursor/Windsurf + VSIX install incl. package:ovsx flow), docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md (adb-not-found + ADB_BLOCKED_HINT firewall/Local Network/VPN/Android 11+/platform-tools 31+ from diagnose.ts); all three linked from README. Verified supported-IDE matrix: VS Code (VS Code Marketplace) + Kiro/Cursor/Windsurf/other VS Code-based hosts (Open VSX or VSIX); JetBrains out of scope. Confirmed engines.vscode stays ^1.85.0 and extensionKind ['ui','workspace'] retained (unchanged). Packaging check: `npm run -w extensions/vscode package` assembled the VSIX with LICENSE.txt + changelog.md + readme.md and NO missing-LICENSE/CHANGELOG warnings; it then failed only on `--out ../../dist/` with ENOTDIR because the stray root `dist` FILE still exists — that file is removed by FEAT-004, so the final packaging write assertion is deferred to FEAT-004 as planned. Did not touch extensions/jetbrains/.
